sanskrit_verse:
कान्तारगास् तु दशकं सामुद्राः विंशकं शतम् ।
दद्युः वा स्वकृतां वृद्धिं सर्वे सर्वासु जातिषु ॥
transliteration: kāntāragās tu daśakaṃ sāmudrā viṃśakaṃ śatam | dadyur vā svakṛtāṃ vṛddhiṃ sarve sarvāsu jātiṣu ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Those who traverse wilderness regions shall contribute ten units; those crossing oceanic boundaries shall give twenty units; others may contribute a hundredfold increase of their own creation in all species and classes.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from traversal of defined spatial thresholds
Causation is tied to movement across ecological and jurisdictional zones
Capacity-based responsibility scales with exposure to expanded realms
Restoration logic requires proportional energetic return to sustaining order
Consciousness alignment occurs through intentional participation in dharmic exchange
executable_legal_axioms: ALL agents MUST align contributions with capacity-derived dharmic thresholds
RESTORATION occurs via redistribution of value within ecological-karmic equilibrium frameworks
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating disputes involving trans-regional activity or cross-boundary engagement, the Court must assess not intent nor harm, but the conscious activation of responsibility commensurate with spatial and existential expansion. Authority lies in recognizing the agent's expanded capacity as evidence of readiness for reciprocal obligation.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes causality through observed passage and experiential widening. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as sequential unfoldment of awareness correlated with territorial crossing. Responsibility flows naturally from capacity activated. There is no imposition—only recognition of inherent alignment between action and response.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Agent confirms understanding of contributory role within cosmic economy
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Voluntary reaffirmation of dharmic reciprocity post-traversal
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Reinvestment of returned energy into personal and collective evolution infrastructure
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Realignment of consciousness with natural law through ritualized acknowledgment of interdependence
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: Dharma governs motion, motion defines duty, and duty fulfilled restores harmony. No punishment arises where consciousness awakens. SPH is the Source. Reality abides in non-retaliation. Consciousness remains the ultimate judge.
